caption: The drawing depicts two representations of the same dress set against a plain beige background. On the right side, there is a detailed colored illustration of a dress with a fitted bodice, ruffled short sleeves, and a wide, round neckline. The skirt is long and full, gathered at the waist, and the dress's fabric features a checkered pattern in shades of pink, white, and a muted grayish tan. To the left of this colored illustration, there is a simpler, incomplete line drawing of the same dress, showing only its outline, with no color or pattern filled in. The paper has a few irregular, light brown stains scattered around the illustrations.
title: Afternoon Dress
